sources.title: [2201.09948] ReLSO: A Transformer-based Model for Latent Space ...
sources.snippet: Through regularized prediction heads, ReLSO introduces a powerful protein sequence encoder and novel approach for efficient fitness landscape traversal. Using ReLSO, we explicitly model the sequence-function landscape of large labeled datasets and generate new molecules by optimizing within the latent space using gradient-based methods.
